steps.instructions: {{prompt}} Work in {{workdirA}}. When you finish, save the output of `git diff` in your work directory as changes.diff in your candidate directory, and add a short notes.md on your design.
{{prompt}} Work in {{workdirB}}. When you finish, save the output of `git diff` in your work directory as changes.diff in your candidate directory, and add a short notes.md on your design.

The inputs are two anonymous outputs for the same request. Grade both in one pass, on one scale, against this rubric: {{rubric}}. Judge from changes.diff and the files, not the notes' claims. When a criterion needs runtime evidence the files cannot show, score it null with the reason instead of 0; the parent grades that from the transcripts. Write grades.json to your candidate directory: for each input, its path, a score per criterion, and one line of evidence per score.
